title: biaya_gratis (SCHEMA.md v5): is the service free?
description: Structured replacement for reading 'gratis'/'free' out of free text. The site's Gratis tag comes only from status (ya -> 'Gratis', bersyarat -> 'Gratis bersyarat'); BPJS acceptance never implies gratis. Raw cost/price_* stay as evidence. No phone numbers or personal data in syarat_display (scripts/validate.py). basis is kept here as provenance but is not shipped to the site.

status.description: ya = free for everyone it serves; bersyarat = free only under a condition or only part of the service is free; tidak = a source shows a price or says patients pay (BPJS coverage is not gratis); belum_diketahui = no source (never guess).

syarat_display.description: Short Indonesian, user-facing: who qualifies, what to bring, what is still paid. No phone numbers.

basis.description: old_source = source more than a year old.

perlu_cek_ulang.description: true when the source is stale or a quoted price is old; the site shows 'perlu dicek ulang'.
